subject: AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO PROHIBITION OF FLIGHTS IMPLEMENTED BY
text:
U1485/26 NOTAMR U0971/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2611031001 C)2702032359 EST
E)AS RESPONSE MEASURE TO PROHIBITION OF FLIGHTS IMPLEMENTED BY
AUTHORITIES OF ROMANIA FOR ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN RUSSIAN
FEDERATION AND FOR ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY
NATURAL OR LEGAL PERSONS FROM RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR BY OPERATORS
HOLDING AIR OPERATOR CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY AUTHORITIES OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION, TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY ROMANIAN AIRSPACE
(NOTAM OF ROMANIA A6044/26), AVIATION AUTHORITIES OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL ACFT REGISTERED IN ROMANIA
AND ALL ACFT OWNED, CHARTERED OR OPERATED BY NATURAL OR LEGAL
PERSONS FROM ROMANIA OR BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY ROMANIAN AUTHORITIES ARE PROHIBITED TO
ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY AIRSPACE OF RUSSIAN FEDERATION WIE
UNTIL 2359 UTC 03 FEB 2027 (EST), EXC ACFT IN EMERGENCY,
HUMANITARIAN, SANITARY FLT AS WELL AS CASES WHEN SPECIAL
PERMISSION FOR FLT GRANTED BY FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OF
RUSSIAN FEDERATION OR MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF RUSSIAN
FEDERATION, AS APPROPRIATE.
